context.body: This is the opening creation sequence, before any human action or later water event.
context.label: Creation setting

observations.body: Darkness is over the deep while God’s Spirit hovers over the waters.
observations.label: Starting condition

observations.body: God separates waters and then gathers the waters below so dry land appears.
observations.label: Separation

observations.body: Dry land is named Earth, and the gathered waters are named Seas.
observations.label: Named places

observations.body: Water is present before the ordered spaces of sea and land are named.
observations.label: Sequence

payload.posture: Notice the order of waters, speech, separation, gathering, and dry land before assigning a symbol.
payload.tension: The passage shows waters being ordered, but it does not explain their origin or reduce them to one later meaning.
payload.title: Waters gathered, dry land appears
